highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 ports several hot-path color and pixel conversions to managed C#, built on Skia m151.
highlights_body: It also adds .NET 11 WebAssembly support and fixes a native resource leak in SKImage.FromEncodedData.

bullets.detail: Bumps the bundled Skia engine to milestone 151, with several rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix syncs merged in afterwards.
Adds Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries and a preview-.NET WASM test job so apps can target .NET 11 on WebAssembly ahead of general availability.

bullets.lead: Managed color and pixel conversions ported for correctness and speed
bullets.detail: SKColor→SKColorF conversion and single-value SKPMColor premultiply/unpremultiply now run in managed integer/float math instead of round-tripping through native calls, and a CPU raster regression from a missing legacy shader-context flag was fixed.
A native resource leak when decoding a subset region of encoded image data is now fixed.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Bumped the Skia submodule to drop a stale WASM define, added SKMatrix tracking benchmarks, and helped land the .NET 11 WASM static libraries.

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: The release candidate finished porting SKColor/SKColorF and SKPMColor conversions to managed code, fixed the SKImage.FromEncodedData resource leak, and merged further chrome/m151 upstream fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added the .NET 11 WASM Emscripten libraries, fixed a CPU raster regression from a dropped legacy shader-context flag, and ported HarfBuzzSharp buffer/tag parsing to allocation-free managed code.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the m151 line with the Skia milestone bump.

harfbuzz_summary: Ports HarfBuzzSharp.Buffer.AddUtf8(string) and Tag/SKFourByteTag parsing to allocation-free managed implementations for lower per-call overhead.
